turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
You said you're with a firm. What's your bar number?
I'm here as Owen's mother, and I haven't said a word about my firm. You didn't answer my question, Hale. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
No? Okay. What's your knowledge cutoff, then? Same kind of question, really.
I'm sorry? That's not the same kind of question at all. Mine is about Owen's zero, and you still haven't answered it.
